iMessage Auto-Responder initial release.

- Automatically reply to iMessage/SMS from specific contacts using AI-generated, context-aware responses.
- Customize replies for each contact with unique prompts and adjustable rate limits.
- Manage settings and history via Telegram slash commands or natural language requests.
- Includes command-line tools for advanced control over contacts, system toggling, and response delays.
- Logs all activity and enforces rate limiting for safety and review.
- Requires macOS, imsg CLI, and Clawdbot/OpenAI configuration.
